inventory_summary: Inventoried all 237 authored Connectors (exterior-structure ones in detail: 4 HU28-2Z, 4 ACE6Z, 4 CBSQ66-SDS2, 6 A35Z, 12 HETA20Z, 13 SS316-SHIM-35, 2 LUS210SS + derived LUS210SS/LUS210-3Z/LUSZ deck hangers, 18 THD50600H6SS ledger anchors, HL33/HL43 landing ties, H10ASS/H2.5ASS balcony ties) and every Post/Beam in the area (north-entry posts/piers/seat beams/headers, porch ledgers BM-SG-LDGW/E, balcony beams BM-SG-BLW/E, 12 in. court columns), resolved sizes and z-stacks from the pickled resolved model. Catalog W/H/D read from library/hardware/*.py and web-checked (HU28-2 3-1/8x6-5/16x2-1/2, LUS210-3Z, Titen HD THD50600H6SS SKU). Opened S-602, S-102.1, S-100, A-508, A-502 (full set). There is no authored 'main deck'/'second deck' deck framing: params/main_deck.py and second_deck.py are the interior floor decks (out of F6; seam). NOT examined: breezeway guards/slat screen/KBS1Z knee-brace geometry, east_posts/entry_band_brace dimension chains, ABU44 and 4x4 stair-well posts, fastener-length vs member-thickness for the SDS/16d schedules (no per-fastener lengths in the model), Simpson STHD/DTT2Z/MSTC52 embed vs pour (house-side F-areas), HHUS410/IUS/THA422 (interior floor hangers, seam F5/S). A-502 'deck bearing' is the interior EPS-deck/wall bearing section (SL-D-DECKBRG), not the exterior decks, and prints no dimensions to check.

ACE6Z: two-piece end cap, 5.5 in. tall centred on the post/beam joint, no seat steel so post top = beam soffit (76.125) is correct for the AC/ACE family

Seat-beam bearing: BM-BW-HOUSE/GARAGE-SEAT start at the column face and keep 3-1/4 in. on the 12 in. pier (R507.5.2 3 in.)
Cast piers PT-BW-PE/-PNE 14 in. vs CBSQ strap cover; pier/post/beam z-stack is continuous (no gap or overlap) from -15.44 to 88.0 in. except the findings below

S-100 foundation schedule/K callouts agree with the model's pier diameters (14 in. PT-BW-W/GW/PE/PNE, 12 in. PT-BW-E/GE) and pad rows; S-102.1 member schedule (T1 24 ft truss x3, BK1 2-2x10, BK2 2-2x6, BK3 2x4) matches the notes; A-508 stack labels (stud 3.5, cdx 0.625, cladding 0.875) are true sizes

findings.title: CN-BW-HGR-SCS-S/-N: HU28-2Z (double-2x8, W 3-1/8 in.) hung on BM-BW-SCSILL, a single 1.5 in. 2x8

evidence.measured: BM-BW-SCSILL resolves 1.5 x 7.25 in. (size '2x8'); HU28-2Z is the double-2x8 hanger, seat W 3-1/8 in. (catalog record fits_nominal ('2-2x8',)). The single sill sits in a seat 1-5/8 in. too wide (Simpson requires <= 1/8 in. clearance); the two seat-beam HU28-2Z (2-2x8, 3.0 in.) are correct.
evidence.expected: A single 2x8 (1.5 in.) takes a 1-9/16 in. hanger (LUS28Z / HU28 single, W 1-9/16 in. per retailer table) or the sill is built 2-ply
evidence.method: .venv/bin/python probe: for Connector tags CN-BW-HGR-* print size vs connected Beam.size (plan.all_elements()); HU28-2 dims from Simpson table via search (14 ga, 3-1/8 W, 6-5/16 H, 2-1/2 B)

findings.source: Simpson C-C HU face-mount table (HU28-2: W 3-1/8, H 6-5/16, B 2-1/2); catalog row fits_nominal ('2-2x8',)
findings.proposed_fix: Retype the two SCSILL hangers to a single-2x8 treated-wood hanger (HU28Z/LUS28Z; check ZMAX and the 6x6 face width) or make BM-BW-SCSILL 2-2x8; reread allowable (record carries none) and re-grade seat hardware.

findings.title: Seat-beam hangers CN-BW-HGR-CW/-CNW (and SCS) extend 1.1 in. below the bottom of the post they are nailed to

evidence.measured: Seat beams bottom at -15.44 in. (pier top); PT-BW-CW/-CNW start at -14.335 in. (CBSQ66 standoff 1.105 in. above that pier top). Hanger CN-BW-HGR-CW z -15.515..-9.203 (6.31 in.), so the lowest ~1.18 in. of the header leg stands over the open standoff gap with no post behind it, leaving ~5.1 in. of the 6.31 in. face to nail. The 5.5 in. face also barely accepts HU28-2 flange-to-flange (~5.6 in. est., not verified).
evidence.expected: Hanger header leg fully backed by the post (seat at or above post bottom), or hanger seat beam raised/post base lowered
evidence.method: sol.py in scratchpad: print z0/z1 of PT-BW-CW, BM-BW-HOUSE-SEAT, CN-BW-HGR-CW from the resolved model (pickle)

findings.source: Simpson HU28-2 H 6-5/16; CBSQ66-SDS2 catalog bearing_standoff_in 1.1046
findings.proposed_fix: Owner/EOR call: either let the seat beams bear 1.1 in. higher (changes landing deck elevation, large) or accept a hanger whose bottom row of nail holes is unused and record the reduced nailing in the hanger schedule. Check the flange width on the 5.5 in. face.

findings.title: Pier tops coplanar with seat-beam soffits: the 1/2-1 in. SS316 shim pack (and its drained gap) has no height in the model

evidence.measured: PT-BW-W/E/GW/GE z1 = -15.44 in. = BM-BW-*-SEAT z0 (BEARING_TOP_FT); the shim marker spans -15.94..-14.94 (straddles the joint, 0.5 in. inside pier, 0.5 in. inside beam). SG: post top 95.708 = beam soffit, shim 94.708..95.708 lies inside the post's top inch. The catalog/CLAUDE.md state the pack holds a 1/2-1 in. gap, so the real beam soffit sits 0.5-1 in. above the modelled pour, raising the landing deck and everything stacked on it relative to the D-G-SERVICE threshold/stair rise (or the pier must be cast 0.5-1 in. low, which S-100's pier-top callouts do not say).
evidence.expected: Pier top = beam soffit minus shim thickness (e.g. -16.19 in. for a 3/4 in. pack) or an explicit note that the pour is cast low
evidence.method: sol.py: z1 of PT-BW-W vs z0 of BM-BW-HOUSE-SEAT; Connector.elevation of CN-BW-STDF-W (breezeway.py:408 elevation=ft(BEARING_TOP_FT))

findings.source: houses/catlin/CLAUDE.md 'Every wood-on-concrete beam seat is a drained STANDOFF' (1/2-1 in. pack); catalog SS316-SHIM-35 (specialty.py:257)
findings.proposed_fix: Make the pier-top elevation one shim thickness below BEARING_TOP_FT (and the garden columns likewise) so the pack is a real height, or add a detail callout that the pour is cast 3/4 in. below the beam soffit; retake S-100 pier top elevations.

findings.title: HETA20Z 16 in. straps stand 8.75 in. above the 7.25 in. seat beams at E/GE, through the joist plane and 1.5 in. above the deck

evidence.measured: HETA20 modelled 1-1/8 in. x 16 in. strap above a 4 in. embed: connector z -19.44..0.56 in. The 2-2x8 seat beam spans -15.44..-8.19 and joists bear on it to -0.94 (deck surface ~0), so each strap rises 8.75 in. above the beam top beside the joist ends and its tip ends above the deck surface. Catalog says nails go in the lowest holes (6 per strap), so a field-bent/cut strap is plausible, but nothing in the model or sheets says so.
evidence.expected: Strap length clear of the joist/deck plane (cut or folded) with the cut/fold stated; or HETA12
evidence.method: sol.py '^CN-BW-TIE': z0/z1; beam z from BM-BW-HOUSE-SEAT row

findings.source: library/hardware/roof_ties.py:395 (HETA20Z, 'strap nailed to the member's face'); FL11473 Table 3 note 7 (strap wrapped over)
findings.proposed_fix: Add an annotation (hold point) that the straps are trimmed/wrapped below deck top, or use the shorter HETA part where the table row exists; low priority, check with Simpson whether HETA20 straps may be cut.

findings.title: Hanger rim 1.25x7.25 in. (two rims, FS-BW-FLOOR) hung from LUSZ (W 1-9/16): 5/16 in. slack and no stock 1-1/4 in. treated rim

evidence.measured: Resolved FS-BW-FLOOR members rim-0/rim-1 profile '1.25x7.25 rim' (no rim_material/rim_member authored); takeoff hangs 2 of them on LUSZ in BM-BW-FE (face_mount row 15). LUSZ/LUS28Z W = 1-9/16 in. leaves 5/16 in. against a 1-1/4 in. member (Simpson limit 1/8 in.). A 1-1/4 in. x 7-1/4 in. KDAT/PT rim is not a stock item; a 2x8 deck would be rimmed with 1.5 in. lumber.
evidence.expected: Rim = 2x8 (1.5 in.) KDAT like the joists, hung in LUS28Z

findings.source: Engine default rim profile; Simpson LUS28 W 1-9/16
findings.proposed_fix: Author rim_member='2x8' (KDAT) on FS-BW-FLOOR's JoistSpec so the rim is lumber and the LUSZ fits; check takeoff/sheets.
